summary: ORA MVP end-to-end validated. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (root, register+seed 5, duplicate 409, login valid+wrong, /auth/me with/without token, priorities shape sorted/no _id, create task, AI resolve returning Italian solution, complete removes from priorities, dismiss removes from priorities, memory add+list+ask referencing stored content, invalid JWT -> 401). Frontend (mobile 390x844 web preview): login screen shows ORA title + 3 buttons (apple/google/email), email form + toggle to register works, demo@ora.app fell back to login on 409 as expected, home shows brand ORA + 'Cosa conta adesso' + 5 priority cards, RISOLVI opens resolve-modal, AI returns Italian solution (~312 chars) within seconds, resolve-close keeps card, resolve-done removes card, all 4 tabs navigable, Memoria search + 3 suggestions work, add-memory saves and follow-up ask returns answer referencing MediaWorld/Roma, Profilo shows demo@ora.app and logout returns to /login. No red screen, no metro errors. One minor RN web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (harmless).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a child View using pointerEvents prop (possibly BlurView/Modal overlay). Cosmetic only. Reference: search project for pointerEvents= usage.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate any 'pointerEvents={...}' JSX prop to 'style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}' to silence RN 0.74+ deprecation warning on web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /auth/register only 409s when existing user has password_hash — this is correct behavior for allowing account-linking with Google, and matches the test expectation (409 on duplicate email+password).
server.py: resolve_task returns 502 on AI failure with exception message included — safe, but consider redacting exception text in production.
AuthContext refresh() clears token on ANY error from /auth/me (including transient network). Acceptable for MVP; could differentiate 401 vs network error later.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Consider migrating to lifespan handler.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create ephemeral TEST_ora_<uuid>@example.com users (not cleaned up automatically; harmless due to unique emails). Frontend flow used demo@ora.app which already existed (409 -> login fallback) and added one memory 'Ho comprato il televisore da MediaWorld a Roma il 5/1/2026.'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_ora_backend.py, uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Frontend testID coverage is excellent: login-*, priority-card-N, priority-resolve-N, priority-dismiss-N, resolve-modal, resolve-solution-text, resolve-close-button, resolve-done-button, memory-search-input, memory-suggestion-N, memory-answer-block, add-*-tile, add-memory-input, add-memory-save-button, add-task-*-input, add-task-save-button, profile-email-text, profile-logout-button. Emergent LLM key produces valid Italian output via gpt-5.2. Google login opens external auth.emergentagent.com — verify presence only.
rca_of_issue: No bugs to root-cause. All requested acceptance criteria met.
